title: Incident call: slow page loads
text:
Kai: I am leading this incident. Page loads are slow for about a third of users since ten o'clock.
Mira: The database looks fine. Query times are normal.
Jon: The content delivery network shows a drop in cache hits starting at ten.
Kai: What changed at ten?
Mira: We released a change to the image sizes. Every image now has a new address.
Jon: That would empty the cache. Every request goes back to our servers until the cache fills again.
Kai: Do we roll back or wait for the cache to warm up?
Jon: Warming up takes about two hours at this traffic. Rolling back takes ten minutes.
Kai: Then we roll back. Mira, please start it.
Mira: Rolling back now.
Jon: Cache hits are climbing again.
Kai: Good. Page loads are back to normal for most users. Let's keep watching for fifteen minutes.
Mira: Next time we change image addresses, we should warm the cache before switching.
Kai: Agreed. I will write that into the release checklist and open a ticket for a warm-up script.
Jon: I will post a summary in the status channel.
